title: bernstein_run_status
description: Poll a verifiable handle for a run started with bernstein_run. Accepts either identifier that call returned: the task_id or the run_id.

run_id.description: The run to project. Either the task_id or the run_id returned by bernstein_run. Resolved journal run id first, then the task id slugified into a journal run id, so both forms reach one journal.
